'''Brian Casmiro''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Virginia Beach Grand Slam]] on 29 July 2000 with [[There Is Good In Him / I Can Save Him|TIGIH]], according to Kelly Newman's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1049">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-29-virginia-beach-gs-7-29-00d1049/ virginia-beach-gs-7-29-00], DeckTech (Kelly "juno23322" Newman, 29 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-29-virginia-beach-gs-7-29-00d1049/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
